answer: Require each new identity to lock a refundable stake that stays frozen for a full epoch before its attestations count. An attacker spawning fifty fake accounts must park fifty stakes, so capital cost grows linearly and slashing hits every one if peers reject the text. An honest agent keeps a single stake and earns it back, so the tundra of idle capital never bites. Like a forge, the bond tempers real work; velvet-smooth spam gets burned.
